管理词库、快捷键与查询窗口的显示方式。: Manage word libraries, shortcuts, and the search window.
选择原始语言与目标语言，并管理对应的用户词库。: Choose source and target languages and manage their word library.
选择一个或多个词库并合并到当前语言词库: Choose one or more libraries to merge into the current language library.
查询框可主动翻译；OCR 与语音识别可按设置自动翻译。: Translate on demand from search; OCR and speech can translate automatically.
声纹已删除，请保存并应用设置: Voiceprint deleted; save and apply settings
声纹与当前播放声过滤设置不一致，请重新注册: Voiceprint capture does not match the current playback-filter setting. Please enroll again.
请用日常麦克风在实际使用环境说三段话，每段至少 1.5 秒，段间停顿约一秒: Use your everyday microphone in your usual environment. Speak three samples of at least 1.5 seconds each, pausing about one second between them.
请依次朗读以下三句话: Read these three sentences in order
请使用平时的麦克风，并保持当前“过滤电脑播放声”设置不变。: Use your everyday microphone and keep the current playback-audio filter setting unchanged.
1. 今天我想试试语音输入，看看识别是否准确。: 1. Today I want to try voice input and see how accurately it recognizes me.
2. 请把这句话记下来，等一下我还会继续说话。: 2. Please write down this sentence; I will keep speaking in a moment.
3. 现在我会用平时的声音，完成最后一段录音。: 3. Now I will use my normal voice to finish the last recording.
点击“注册本人声纹”后先等约 1 秒，再逐句朗读。每句说约 3–5 秒，每句后（: After clicking Register my voice, wait about one second, then read each sentence. Speak for roughly 3–5 seconds per sentence and pause for about one second after each, including the last. Check that progress shows 1/3, 2/3, then 3/3.
当前程序要求三段各至少 1.5 秒，并靠停顿分段；使用不同句子也能提供更丰富的声: Each sample must be at least 1.5 seconds; pauses separate the samples. Different sentences also provide a richer voice sample.
使用本地声纹模型判断说话人；需要先录制三段本人语音。多人同时说话、录音回放或环境: Checks the speaker with a local model after three enrollment samples. Overlapping voices, playback, or environment changes can cause errors; this is not secure authentication.
优先使用 Windows 通信麦克风的回声消除；设备不支持时改用系统播放声回采和: Uses Windows microphone echo cancellation when available, or system playback loopback with software cancellation otherwise. It only reduces computer playback, not phone audio or nearby speakers; headphones also help.
本地录音与识别；无词库匹配时使用已配置的 DeepSeek 翻译。: Record and recognize locally; use DeepSeek when the library has no match.
经常说同一种语言时，手动指定可减少短句误判。: If you usually speak one language, selecting it can improve short-phrase recognition.
SenseVoice 自动识别语言，不能通过此选项限定；识别语言设置仅用于 Wh: SenseVoice detects the language automatically; this selection applies only to Whisper.
默认说完一句后自动停止；勾选后持续监听下一句，再按快捷键结束。: Normally stops after one sentence. Enable to keep listening; press the shortcut again to stop.
按住语音快捷键说话，松开后停止: Hold shortcut to talk; release to stop
启用后按下快捷键开始录音，松开快捷键的主按键时停止并识别最后一句。按住期间可连续: Press the shortcut to start recording. Releasing its main key stops and recognizes the final sentence. You can speak multiple sentences while holding it; this takes precedence over continuous speech input.
点击数值后滚轮调整，每次 0.1 秒: Click the value, then scroll in 0.1-second steps.
范围 0.2–3.0 秒，默认 0.6 秒。按住说话模式会等到松开快捷键才提交，: Range: 0.2–3.0 seconds; default: 0.6. Hold-to-talk submits on release, so this does not apply in that mode.
多条词库匹配时自动输入第一条: Use first result when multiple entries match
关闭后会打开查询框，供你自行选择匹配结果。: If disabled, the search window opens so you can choose a result.
Aion2 兼容模式：复制语音结果，手动粘贴: Aion2 compatibility: copy speech result for manual paste
默认关闭；仅在 Aion2 位于前台时生效，其他程序仍自动输入。: Off by default. Only applies while Aion2 is in the foreground; other apps still receive automatic input.
后退/前进键若录制为 MouseX1/MouseX2，可直接使用；其他按键只有在: Back/Forward buttons recorded as MouseX1/MouseX2 work directly. Other buttons can be recorded as Mouse6–Mouse8 only if the driver exposes separate mouse events.
DPI、G-Shift 等按键可在 G HUB 中分别映射为不同的键盘快捷键，再: In G HUB, assign DPI, G-Shift, and other buttons to distinct keyboard shortcuts, then record each one above. F13–F24 are good choices if G HUB offers them and they do not conflict with other apps.
重新映射会替换该按键原来的 DPI 或 G-Shift 功能。: Remapping replaces that button's original DPI or G-Shift function.
如切换到游戏后快捷键失效，请检查 G HUB 是否切换了配置文件；可将映射配置设: If a shortcut stops working in a game, check whether G HUB changed profiles. You can make the mapping profile persistent.
确认 AI 译文后自动保存到当前语言词库: Auto-save confirmed AI translations to current library
AI 正向或反向翻译时，按译文语言使用自然礼貌的表达；没有专门敬语形式的语言会使: Use naturally polite expressions in the output language for either translation direction. Languages without honorific forms use a polite tone. Existing library phrases are unchanged.
已安全保存；留空则保持不变: Stored securely; leave blank to keep
密钥保存在 Windows 凭据管理器，不写入 to_words.db。未选择目: The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager, not to_words.db. Translation requires a target language.
保存并应用后将删除已保存的密钥。: The saved key will be deleted when you save and apply.
OCR 识别后自动翻译成原始语言: Translate OCR text to source language
松开截图选区后自动显示纯文字译文；点击 √ 才复制 OCR 原文并关闭。开启后仅: After selecting a screen area, show the translation as plain text. Click √ to copy the original OCR text and close. Only recognized text is sent to DeepSeek, not the screenshot. Auto-detect source translates to Simplified Chinese. Requires an API key and may incur charges.
自动检测当前使用：{language}；语言难以判断时沿用该词库。缺少的词库会自: Auto-detect currently uses {language}; if uncertain, this library is retained. Missing libraries are created automatically.
缺少的词库会自动创建，不会覆盖已有词条。: Missing libraries are created automatically without overwriting existing entries.
Enter 复制后仍保持查询框打开: Keep search open after Enter copies
复制后切出查询框，再次返回时清空全部输入: Clear all input when returning after copying

使用结构化表格维护词条，或在高级模式中直接编辑 JSON。: Edit entries in a table or edit raw JSON in advanced mode.
将格式化后的 JSON 导出到 word_libraries 词库目录: Export formatted JSON to the word_libraries directory.
默认使用 key/value 表格编辑；保存时会自动剔除重复 key 和空白项。: Edit key/value pairs in the table. Duplicate keys and empty entries are removed on save.
高级模式：直接修改 JSON。key 和 value 都必须是字符串。: Advanced mode: edit JSON directly. Keys and values must be strings.
粘贴 JSON 对象；导入内容会追加到现有表格，重复 key 在保存时去重。: Paste a JSON object. Imported entries are added to the table; duplicate keys are removed on save.
请输入导出文件名，文件将保存到 word_libraries 词库目录：: Enter a file name. The file will be saved in word_libraries:
现有词库格式错误，已进入高级编辑模式: The library has invalid JSON; advanced mode is open.
无法切换到表格，JSON 格式错误: Cannot switch to table: invalid JSON
已找到“{query}”，继续查找将定位下一处。: Found “{query}”. Find again for the next occurrence.
已保存 {count} 个词条；剔除重复 key {duplicates} 项、: Saved {count} entries; removed {duplicates} duplicate keys, {empty_keys} empty keys, and {empty_values} empty values.
导出失败：文件名不能为空。: Export failed: file name cannot be empty.
导出失败：请只输入文件名，不要包含目录路径。: Export failed: enter a file name without a directory path.
导出失败：文件名包含 Windows 不允许的字符。: Export failed: the name contains characters not allowed by Windows.
勾选一个或多个来源文件，内容将写入当前语言词库。: Select one or more source files to merge into the current language library.
没有其他可合并的 JSON 词库: No other JSON libraries available to merge.
已合并 {files} 个词库：新增 {added} 项，跳过重复 {dupli: Merged {files} libraries: {added} added, {duplicates} duplicates skipped, {conflicts} conflicts overwritten; {total} entries now.
本地 OCR：未找到 Tesseract，请先安装或设置 TESSERACT_E: Local OCR: Tesseract not found. Install it or set TESSERACT_EXE.
屏幕 OCR 目前仅支持 Windows。: Screen OCR is currently supported only on Windows.
